cards.headline: Fed holds rates steady, signals one more cut is likely before year end
cards.summary: Policymakers left the benchmark rate unchanged after a two-day meeting. The statement noted cooling inflation and a softer job market.
cards.why_it_matters: Mortgage and car-loan rates track these moves. Markets now price a December cut as likely.

sources.title: Fed holds rates steady, signals one more cut is likely before year end

cards.headline: Humanoid robot startup Kestrel raises $400M to build a factory fleet
cards.summary: The fictional Austin company says the round funds 1,000 general-purpose robots for warehouse and auto plants by 2028.
cards.why_it_matters: The biggest robotics round this year, and another sign investors expect humanoids in real factories soon.

sources.title: Humanoid robot startup Kestrel raises $400M to build a factory fleet

cards.headline: Northland and Southmark agree 30-day ceasefire in Vell Valley
cards.summary: Negotiators signed a pause after two days of talks, the first halt in fighting since spring.
cards.why_it_matters: A pause could ease pressure on shipping lanes that carry US-bound goods.

sources.title: Northland and Southmark agree 30-day ceasefire in Vell Valley

cards.headline: Chipmaker Arcfield opens first 2-nanometer line in Arizona
cards.summary: The fictional firm began volume production at its Phoenix plant, two quarters behind its original schedule.
cards.why_it_matters: The most advanced chips made on US soil to date, a milestone for supply-chain security.

sources.title: Chipmaker Arcfield opens first 2-nanometer line in Arizona

cards.headline: Port of Calloway strike enters third week as freight rates climb
cards.summary: Dock workers extended their walkout. Spot container rates on the route rose 4 percent this week.
cards.why_it_matters: Longer delays could raise costs for US importers ahead of the holidays.

sources.title: Port of Calloway strike enters third week as freight rates climb

cards.headline: Lander touches down near the lunar south pole
cards.summary: A fictional commercial lander set down upright and sent its first images within an hour.
cards.why_it_matters: It carries NASA instruments hunting for water ice, a key resource for future crewed bases.

sources.title: Lander touches down near the lunar south pole

cards.headline: Senate passes stopgap bill, averting a shutdown until January
cards.summary: The vote was 71 to 27. The House is expected to take it up on Thursday.
cards.why_it_matters: Federal paychecks, parks and agency services continue without interruption for now.

sources.title: Senate passes stopgap bill, averting a shutdown until January

cards.headline: New open-weights AI model rivals top closed systems on coding tests
cards.summary: A fictional lab released the weights for free use. Independent testers confirmed most of its benchmark claims.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheaper capable models put pressure on paid AI services and change what startups can build.

sources.title: New open-weights AI model rivals top closed systems on coding tests

cards.headline: Oil slips below $70 as producers signal higher output
cards.summary: Benchmark crude fell 3 percent after a producer group hinted at easing supply cuts next quarter.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheaper oil feeds into lower gas prices within a few weeks.

sources.title: Oil slips below $70 as producers signal higher output

cards.headline: Supreme Court agrees to hear major case on social media age checks
cards.summary: The justices will decide whether states can require platforms to verify user ages.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling could change how millions of teenagers sign up for apps nationwide.

sources.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear major case on social media age checks

cards.headline: Ransomware attack halts operations at a regional hospital chain
cards.summary: The fictional Meridian Health diverted ambulances from four hospitals while systems were restored.
cards.why_it_matters: Hospitals remain a top ransomware target. Federal agencies issued a new alert to providers.

sources.title: Ransomware attack halts operations at a regional hospital chain

cards.headline: Jobless claims fall to lowest level in two months
cards.summary: Weekly first-time claims dropped to 212,000, below economists' expectations.
cards.why_it_matters: A sturdier job market makes the Fed less likely to cut quickly.

sources.title: Jobless claims fall to lowest level in two months

cards.headline: Record heat closes schools across southern Europe
cards.summary: Temperatures topped 44°C in parts of three countries, the latest October reading on record.
cards.why_it_matters: Extreme heat is moving into new seasons, with knock-on effects for tourism and crops.

sources.title: Record heat closes schools across southern Europe

cards.headline: Electric truck maker Volt Haul cuts 20% of staff
cards.summary: The fictional company blamed slower orders and said it would focus on one model.
cards.why_it_matters: EV trucking is consolidating as subsidies shrink and fleets wait for cheaper batteries.

sources.title: Electric truck maker Volt Haul cuts 20% of staff

cards.headline: China announces new export limits on rare-earth magnets
cards.summary: Exporters will need licenses for high-grade magnets starting next month.
cards.why_it_matters: Those magnets go into US motors, drones and wind turbines, and alternatives take years to build.

sources.title: China announces new export limits on rare-earth magnets

cards.headline: Warehouse robots now handle half of orders at fictional retailer Brightcart
cards.summary: The company said robotic picking cut fulfillment time by a third across 40 sites.
cards.why_it_matters: A concrete sign of automation spreading from pilots to most of a major retailer's network.

sources.title: Warehouse robots now handle half of orders at fictional retailer Brightcart

cards.headline: Stocks hit record high led by AI chip shares
cards.summary: The broad index rose 1.2 percent. Chip stocks gained more than 4 percent on strong demand forecasts.
cards.why_it_matters: Retirement accounts are up sharply this year, but the gains are concentrated in a few companies.

sources.title: Stocks hit record high led by AI chip shares

cards.headline: Drone defense system shoots down swarm in Army field test
cards.summary: A fictional laser-plus-interceptor system knocked out 40 small drones in under two minutes.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap drones are reshaping warfare. The Pentagon wants low-cost ways to stop them at scale.

sources.title: Drone defense system shoots down swarm in Army field test

cards.headline: Election officials certify results after record mail-in turnout in Velmora
cards.summary: The fictional country's election saw 78 percent turnout. The opposition conceded peacefully.
cards.why_it_matters: A smooth handover in a key trading partner reassures investors and diplomats.

sources.title: Election officials certify results after record mail-in turnout in Velmora

cards.headline: Gene therapy restores partial sight in early trial
cards.summary: Eight of twelve patients with an inherited eye disease could read large print after one treatment.
cards.why_it_matters: One more step toward one-time cures for diseases that now need lifelong care.

sources.title: Gene therapy restores partial sight in early trial

cards.headline: EU fines fictional platform Chirp €1.2 billion over data transfers
cards.summary: Regulators said user data moved to US servers without adequate protections.
cards.why_it_matters: US tech companies face growing legal costs in Europe, and transatlantic data rules are still unsettled.

sources.title: EU fines fictional platform Chirp €1.2 billion over data transfers

cards.headline: Middle East talks resume on Red Sea shipping security
cards.summary: Envoys met for the first time in two months to discuss naval escorts and insurance rules.
cards.why_it_matters: About 12 percent of world trade passes through the Red Sea. Disruptions lift prices everywhere.

sources.title: Middle East talks resume on Red Sea shipping security

cards.headline: Self-driving taxis expand to three more US cities
cards.summary: A fictional operator added Denver, Nashville and Miami, bringing its service to nine metros.
cards.why_it_matters: Driverless rides are moving from novelty to a normal option in more American cities.

sources.title: Self-driving taxis expand to three more US cities

cards.headline: Startup builds a robot hand that can thread a needle
cards.summary: The fictional lab's 22-joint hand learned the task from 40 hours of human demos.
cards.why_it_matters: Dexterous hands are the hardest part of useful humanoids. This is a notable jump.

sources.title: Startup builds a robot hand that can thread a needle

cards.headline: Inflation cools to 2.6%, the lowest in 18 months
cards.summary: Consumer prices rose less than expected last month as rent and used-car prices eased.
cards.why_it_matters: Cooler inflation gives the Fed room to keep cutting, which would lower borrowing costs.

sources.title: Inflation cools to 2.6%, the lowest in 18 months

cards.headline: Ceasefire largely holds on first full day, monitors say
cards.summary: International observers reported only minor violations along the Vell Valley line.
cards.why_it_matters: A lasting pause would steady energy prices and let aid reach civilians.

sources.title: Ceasefire largely holds on first full day, monitors say

cards.headline: Rocket startup Halcyon nails first booster landing
cards.summary: The fictional company recovered its booster on a barge on its third attempt.
cards.why_it_matters: More reusable rockets mean cheaper launches and more competition for satellite contracts.

sources.title: Rocket startup Halcyon nails first booster landing

cards.headline: House committee advances bill to set national AI safety rules
cards.summary: The bill would require testing and incident reports for the largest models. It passed committee 30 to 19.
cards.why_it_matters: It would be the first federal AI law, and it could override a patchwork of state rules.

sources.title: House committee advances bill to set national AI safety rules

cards.headline: Automakers scramble for magnets after China's export limits
cards.summary: Two fictional carmakers warned of production slowdowns if licenses take more than a month.
cards.why_it_matters: Shortages could slow EV and hybrid production and lift car prices.

sources.title: Automakers scramble for magnets after China's export limits

cards.headline: Robot lawnmower recall covers 300,000 units
cards.summary: The fictional maker said a sensor fault could fail to stop the blades when lifted.
cards.why_it_matters: Check your model number. Owners can get a free repair.

sources.title: Robot lawnmower recall covers 300,000 units

cards.headline: Bond yields fall as traders bet on faster Fed cuts
cards.summary: The 10-year yield dropped to its lowest level since spring after the inflation report.
cards.why_it_matters: Lower yields usually pull mortgage rates down within days.

sources.title: Bond yields fall as traders bet on faster Fed cuts

cards.headline: Wildfire smoke blankets three western states
cards.summary: Air quality alerts covered 20 million people as fires burned in dry, windy conditions.
cards.why_it_matters: Smoke season is getting longer. Health officials urge masks and filters for sensitive groups.

sources.title: Wildfire smoke blankets three western states

cards.headline: Port of Calloway strike ends with 9% wage deal
cards.summary: Workers ratified a three-year contract. Ships began unloading within hours.
cards.why_it_matters: Shipping backlogs should clear in two to three weeks, in time for holiday inventory.

sources.title: Port of Calloway strike ends with 9% wage deal

cards.headline: Quantum computing firm claims error-correction milestone
cards.summary: The fictional Qubitron showed logical qubits that held data 10 times longer than physical ones.
cards.why_it_matters: Error correction is the main hurdle before quantum computers can do useful work.

sources.title: Quantum computing firm claims error-correction milestone

cards.headline: Teacher strike closes schools in fictional Ridgeport district
cards.summary: Teachers walked out after talks over class sizes and pay collapsed overnight.
cards.why_it_matters: It's the third big-city teacher strike this year, as districts face tight budgets.

sources.title: Teacher strike closes schools in fictional Ridgeport district

cards.headline: Navy unveils autonomous submarine prototype
cards.summary: The 50-foot uncrewed vessel can patrol for months without surfacing, the Navy said.
cards.why_it_matters: Robot submarines could change how the US watches contested waters in the Pacific.

sources.title: Navy unveils autonomous submarine prototype

cards.headline: African Union backs plan for a continental payments system
cards.summary: Leaders endorsed a fictional system to settle trade in local currencies.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheaper cross-border payments could speed up trade with one of the fastest-growing regions.

sources.title: African Union backs plan for a continental payments system

cards.headline: Championship series opens with a 14-inning thriller
cards.summary: The fictional Harbor City Gulls won game one on a walk-off double after midnight.
cards.why_it_matters: Ratings are up as the shorter, pitch-clock game wins back younger viewers.

sources.title: Championship series opens with a 14-inning thriller

cards.headline: Fictional chat app Huddle leaks data on 4 million users
cards.summary: A misconfigured server exposed emails and phone numbers for about a week.
cards.why_it_matters: Change your password and watch for phishing messages if you have an account.

sources.title: Fictional chat app Huddle leaks data on 4 million users

cards.headline: Japan and South Korea sign chip supply pact
cards.summary: The deal pools materials stockpiles and shares supply alerts.
cards.why_it_matters: Allied chip supply chains matter as US firms rely on both countries for key parts.

sources.title: Japan and South Korea sign chip supply pact

cards.headline: Grid operators warn of tight winter power supply in Texas
cards.summary: A fictional reliability report flagged risk during long cold snaps.
cards.why_it_matters: Power demand from data centers is rising faster than new generation.

sources.title: Grid operators warn of tight winter power supply in Texas

cards.headline: Appeals court blocks new rule on overtime pay
cards.summary: The court said the agency overstepped its authority under labor law.
cards.why_it_matters: About 4 million salaried workers who would have gained overtime won't for now.

sources.title: Appeals court blocks new rule on overtime pay

cards.headline: Robotics foundation model learns tasks from YouTube videos
cards.summary: Researchers at a fictional lab trained a robot policy on 100,000 hours of online video.
cards.why_it_matters: Training on video instead of costly robot demos could speed up general-purpose robots.

sources.title: Robotics foundation model learns tasks from YouTube videos

cards.headline: Cocoa prices hit record as West African harvest falls short
cards.summary: Futures jumped 8 percent after export estimates were cut again.
cards.why_it_matters: Expect pricier chocolate by the holidays.

sources.title: Cocoa prices hit record as West African harvest falls short
